title: Training Questions: The Release Confirmation-Copy Charge (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
**Q. What is the release confirmation-copy charge?**
On the release of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing, the release confirmation lists each amendment entered on the filing's record today. The release confirmation-copy charge follows how many there are:

| Amendments entered on the filing's record today | Release confirmation-copy charge |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 3.00 |
| Exactly one | 1.50 |
| None | Nothing |

**Q. Which amendments count?**
Every amendment entry on the filing's record whose entry date is today, whatever its reason — vehicle change, address change, policy number change or name change. Amendments entered on earlier days are not counted.

**Q. Hypothetical: an address change and a vehicle change were both entered on the filing's record this morning. What is the charge?**
Two amendments entered today: 3.00.

**Q. Hypothetical: a name change was entered yesterday and nothing today.**
None entered today: no release confirmation-copy charge.
